name: Westwood Park Day Camps (Sports Camps at Westwood Park)
description_short: The YMCA runs week-long sports day camps for grades 1-12 at Westwood Park, an indoor facility with basketball/volleyball courts and a turf field. There are full-week camps for grades 1-6, half-day camps for older kids, and Dig Deep volleyball clinics.

warnings: The page shows the 2026 season, and every date on it is already past (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.
Volleyball session dates have no year on the page. I assumed 2026 because the page refers to the 2026 Summer Camp Guide.

Prices come in three tiers: YMCA Family Member, YMCA Youth Member and Community Member. Session prices and price_per_week use the Community (non-member) rate. For full-week All-Star camps the rates are $290 Family, $315 Youth and $440 Community. Volleyball clinics run from $220 (Family) to $525 (Community, Intermediate).

The weekly All-Star sports camps (Basketball, Flag Football, Girls on the Go!, NinjaZone, Pickleball, Soccer) and the Semi-Pro half-day camps have no dates listed, so they could not be added as sessions.

Grade ranges conflict. Girls on the Go! is labeled Grades 1-6 but described as 'for girls entering grades 1–3'. Semi-Pro is labeled Grades 5-9, but its camp descriptions say grades 7–9. All-Star is labeled Grades 1-9, but the age groups listed only cover grades 1-6.
The page lists two Advanced Skills volleyball camps (Setter/Hitter and Defense) on the same dates and times (July 8-9, 6:00-8:30pm).
Boys Basketball Camp is labeled 'Week 6', but the page does not give week dates.
The Daxko registration link on the page is for School Age Childcare, not summer camp.
